description: Manage walkerOS projects. List, create, update, delete projects, or set a default project for CLI operations.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous list response. Only used with the list action.

limit.description: Max items per page (1-100). Only used with the list action.

name.description: Required for create and update (update also requires projectId).

projectId.description: Required for get, update, delete, set_default.
